verdict.rationale: AMD ships GAIA, described as 'AMD's open-source framework for building intelligent AI agents that run locally by default on AMD Ryzen AI hardware,' which shows agentic software tied to this chip, but it is a developer framework for building agents rather than a ready-to-use built-in assistant a general user can delegate tasks to out of the box. missing for 10: evidence of a shipped, user-facing assistant UI on the product, task-delegation examples, independent hands-on confirmation of GAIA acting as an assistant.
